# Webhooks (Cin7 Core API v2)

Group `Webhooks` of the Cin7 Core API reference. Base URL `https://inventory.dearsystems.com/ExternalApi/v2/`; every request carries the `api-auth-accountid` and `api-auth-applicationkey` headers (see `../api-basics.md`). 4 actions on 1 resources, 1 field tables.

| Action | Path |
|---|---|
| [GET](#get-webhooks) | `GET /webhooks` |
| [POST](#post-webhooks) | `POST /webhooks` |
| [PUT](#put-webhooks) | `PUT /webhooks` |
| [DELETE](#delete-webhooks) | `DELETE /webhooks?ID={ID}` |


To be able to use webhooks, you should have automation module added to your Cin7 Core subscribtion. For details, please contact support.

There is a limit of 5 webhooks of the same type at the same time.

System will try to send webhook 6 times:
first time - in 1 minute after event.

all other attempts - will be based on current attempt number

2 -> 5 minutes after 1

3 -> 10 minutes after 2

4 -> 15 minutes after 3

5 -> 20 minutes after 4

6 -> 25 minutes after 5

if all attempts will be failed, system will deactivate this webhook

## Webhooks

Path: `/webhooks`

### Available fields for Webhooks
| Property | Type           | Length | Required |Notes       |
|:-------|----------------------|---------|----------|----------|
| `ID`  | Guid           |         |Yes*|Unique ID. Required for PUT     |
| `Type`  | String           |         |Yes|Webhook Type. Available values are  <a href="#webhookTypeValues"><b>values</b></a>   |
| `Name`  | String           |         ||Webhook Friendly Name. Read-only.    |
| `IsActive`  | Boolean           |         |Yes|Is webhook active.    |
| `ExternalURL`  | String           |         |Yes|Callback url.   |
| `ExternalAuthorizationType`  | String           |         |Yes|Authorisation type. Available values are `noauth`,`basicauth`, and `bearerauth` |
| `ExternalUserName`  | String           |         |Yes*|User name. Required if `ExternalAuthorizationType` is `basicauth` |
| `ExternalPassword`  | String           |         |Yes*|Password. Required if `ExternalAuthorizationType` is `basicauth` |
| `ExternalBearerToken`  | String           |         |Yes*|Bearer token. Required if `ExternalAuthorizationType` is `bearerauth` |
| `ExternalHeaders`  | Array of Key and Value objects.|         ||Additional headers.|

<a id="webhookTypeValues"></a>
